title: India A-NZ A series ends in draws as Bumrah, Jadeja miss match practice
description:
Jasprit Bumrah and Ravindra Jadeja's hopes of getting some serious game time went down the drain as the third unofficial Test between India A and New Zealand A ended in a draw after the fourth and final day of the match was washed out here on Tuesday.
The third day of the match was also washed out on Monday. The overall honours were shared by both teams as all three games ended in draws.
India A had scored 464 for 5, riding on Yashasvi Jaiswal's second hundred of the series and half-centuries from Sai Sudharsan, Dhruv Jurel, Tilak Verma and Washington Sundar.
New Zealand A had ended the second day's play at 36 for no loss.
The third game was crucial from an Indian perspective as Bumrah and Jadeja were expected to get some game time after coming back from a break.
Bumrah had last played on October 3 during the Asian Games final against Pakistan in Japan's Aichi-Nagoya.
